No. 20-1775 

IN THE  
SUPREME COURT OF THE UNITED STATES 

THE STATE OF ARIZONA, ET AL., 

Petitioners, 

v. 

CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO, ET AL.,  

Respondents. 

ON PETITION FOR A WRIT OF CERTIORARI  
TO THE UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS  
FOR THE NINTH CIRCUIT 

CITY AND COUNTY SAN FRANCISCO AND  
COUNTY OF SANTA CLARA’S  
BRIEF IN OPPOSITION  

Dennis J. Herrera 
  San Francisco City Attorney 
Jesse C. Smith 
Ronald P. Flynn 
Yvonne R. Meré 
Sara J. Eisenberg 
  Counsel of Record 
  Deputy City Attorneys 
City Attorney’s Office 
City Hall Room 234 
One Dr. Carlton B. Goodlett Pl. 
San Francisco, CA 94102 
Telephone: (415) 554-4633 
Sara.Eisenberg@sfcityatty.org 

James R. Williams 
  County Counsel 
County of Santa Clara  
Greta S. Hansen 
Laura Trice 
Raphael N. Rajendra  
Julia B. Spiegel 
H. Luke Edwards 
Hannah Kieschnick 
  Deputy County Counsels  
70 West Hedding Street 
East Wing, Ninth Floor 
San Jose, CA  95110-1770 
Telephone: 

(408) 299-5900 

Attorneys for Respondent 
City and County of San Francisco 

Attorneys for Respondent 
County of Santa Clara

REASONS FOR DENYING PETITION 

Respondents City and County of San Francisco and County of Santa Clara hereby 

join in the Brief in Opposition filed by the States of California, Maine, Oregon, 

Pennsylvania, and the District of Columbia (“States’ Brief in Opposition”).  

San Francisco and Santa Clara agree that the Petition for Certiorari should be 

denied for the reasons stated in the States’ Brief in Opposition. 

Respectfully submitted, 

Dennis J. Herrera   
  San Francisco City Attorney 

James R. Williams 
  County Counsel, County of Santa Clara 

by: /s/ Sara J. Eisenberg  
  Sara J. Eisenberg  

by: /s/ Raphael N. Rajendra
